name: Spinner
statusNote: Alpha in Primer React, accessibility-reviewed 2025-01-08; stable in practice and used inside Button's loading state. The aria-label prop is deprecated in favour of srText.
summary: An indeterminate loading indicator: a rotating quarter arc over a faint ring. Use it when the wait has no known length; use ProgressBar when progress is measurable and skeletons when the shape of the coming content is known.

inputs.name: srText
inputs.description: Text for assistive technology; null when the loading state is already described by visible text.

inputs.name: delay
inputs.description: Render nothing until the delay passes: short 300ms, long (or true) 1000ms, or a number of ms.

anatomy.name: Track
anatomy.description: A full circle of radius 7 in a 16-unit viewBox, stroked 2px in the current text colour at 25% opacity.

anatomy.name: Arc
anatomy.description: A quarter of the same circle, from 3 o'clock to 12 o'clock, stroked 2px in the current text colour with round caps; the whole drawing rotates.

anatomy.name: Screen-reader text
anatomy.description: Visually hidden srText after the graphic.

variants.description: 16px; the size Button uses for its loading state.

layout.text: The spinner is a square of 16, 32 or 64px (small, medium, large) drawn from a 16 by 16 viewBox scaled to fit; its box adds no line height (inline-flex).

Track: circle centre (8, 8), radius 7 viewBox units (7px at small, scaling with size), stroke width 2px at 25% opacity. Arc: path M15 8 a7 7 0 0 0 -7 -7 (a 90 degree arc from the rightmost point to the top), stroke width 2px, round caps. Both strokes are non-scaling: they stay 2px at every size while the radius scales.
Both strokes use the current text colour (currentColor); the spinner has no colour token of its own and takes the colour of its context (e.g. a button's text).

states.text: Always animating while rendered: one full clockwise turn per --base-duration-1000 (1000ms), --base-easing-linear, repeating forever.

behaviour.text: With a delay the spinner renders nothing (takes no space) until 300ms (short), 1000ms (true or long) or the given ms have passed; unmounting before then cancels it.

Every spinner is phase-locked to one global clock: on becoming visible it starts its animation at -(now mod 1000ms), so all spinners on screen show the same angle. Native: angle = 360 deg * ((clockMs mod 1000) / 1000).
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the spinner still rotates; only the phase lock is skipped.

accessibility.role: none (the graphic is aria-hidden; the srText is plain text)
semantics: The svg is aria-hidden; a visually hidden span with srText ("Loading" by default) follows it and is read in reading order.
srText null renders no text, for when visible text already says what is loading.
It is not a live region: appearing does not announce anything. A caller that needs an announcement (as Button's loading does) adds a status region.

notes.text: The animation is a CSS rotation of an SVG; a native build redraws each frame while a spinner is visible (an immediate-mode loop must keep requesting frames while one is on screen). Angle comes from a shared clock, not per-instance start time.

Reduced motion does not stop the spinner, unlike ProgressBar's and SkeletonBox's shimmer, which only run under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. Follow Primer (keep rotating) or choose deliberately; an indeterminate spinner that stops reads as frozen.
vector-effect non-scaling-stroke keeps the stroke 2px at 32 and 64px; a native build scales the radius with size but not the stroke.
The size map, 25% track opacity, 2px stroke, the 300ms and 1000ms delays and the 1000ms sync period are literals; the animation itself reads --base-duration-1000 and --base-easing-linear.
